title: Create a free educational worksheet generator methodology
description: Generate a reusable educational artifact that can later be listed, sold, licensed, or used to earn paid service work.
beneficiary: educators and learners who need reusable worksheet structure
evidence_notes: The output can be locally inspected for usefulness, truthfulness, and limitations.

title: Create a free accessibility checklist and audit template
description: Create an accessibility audit checklist for small public-good projects.
beneficiary: small public-good projects and their users
evidence_notes: The checklist gives observable checks and avoids claiming legal compliance.

title: Create a pantry/resource efficiency tracker template
description: Create a practical template that helps families or small nonprofits reduce waste.
beneficiary: households and small nonprofits managing limited resources
evidence_notes: The tracker is a simple local planning aid and avoids nutrition or food-safety claims.
